sources.title: Jiefangbei Pedestrian Street - ChinaGoTrip
sources.content:
Jiefangbei Pedestrian Street stands as one of Chongqing's most iconic landmarks, representing the first commercial walking street in Western China. This historic district merges traditional heritage with modern urban culture.

Getting There: Metro Line 2 to Linjiangmen Station. Bus routes 462, 466 (Jiefangbei Station) or 132, 181 (Wuyi Road). Taxi service available but peak hour congestion should be considered.

People's Liberation Monument: Standing 27.5 meters tall, this octagonal structure was originally built in 1940 as the "Spirit Fortress." Features clock faces on four sides and seasonal flower beds. Early morning visits recommended for peaceful viewing.

Guotai Arts Center: Distinctive red building occupying 2.91 hectares taking six years to complete. Locals call it the "Chopsticks Building" due to its unique appearance. Hosts regular performances and exhibitions.

Shopping: Luxury brands at Golden Eagle Fortune Center (GUCCI, Louis Vuitton, Prada). Mid-range options at Ba Yi Plaza, Times Square, Sun and Moon Plaza.

Dining: Traditional restaurants include Old Qiu Qiu (70-year-old establishment) and Lin Hua Restaurant. Hot pot venues like Dong Ma and Pearl Sister offer signature broths.

Practical Tips: Pack weather-appropriate clothing for humid climate. Request mild food options if needed. Secure valuables in crowded areas.

sources.title: Jiefangbei Pedestrian Street Travel Guide 2026
sources.content:
Jiefangbei Pedestrian Street, also known as Liberation Monument Pedestrian Street, is a vibrant commercial hub located in the heart of Chongqing. Located in the center of downtown Chongqing, Jiefangbei CBD is the busiest and most prosperous business district in West China.

The street is located in Yuzhong District, with the People's Liberation Monument at its center. Jiefangbei encompasses the surrounding Minquan Road, Zourong Road, Bayi Road and Wuyi Road.

Lines 1, 2, and 6 run through the Jiefangbei area. Closest stations are Linjiangmen (Line 2) and Jiaochangkou (Line 1).

The monument was built in 1945 to commemorate China's victory in the War of Resistance Against Japan. It was renamed the "People's Liberation Monument" in 1949. Standing 27.5 meters tall with an octagonal design.

Within a 500-meter radius you can visit Luohan Temple, Hongya Cave, and Huguang Guild Hall. Free entry with recommended sightseeing time of 1-3 hours.

sources.title: Jiefangbei Pedestrian Street | ichongqing
sources.content: Jiefangbei Pedestrian Street is Chongqing's premier shopping and entertainment district, centered around the iconic People's Liberation Monument. The area features modern shopping malls, traditional restaurants, and historical landmarks. Open 24 hours with shops typically operating from 10:00 AM to 10:00 PM. Free to walk around.

sources.title: Jiefangbei Pedestrian Street Chongqing, Shopping Street
sources.content: Jiefangbei Pedestrian Street is Chongqing's most famous commercial pedestrian street and shopping area. The street features modern department stores, international brands, and traditional Chinese shops. The surrounding area includes many restaurants and food stalls offering Chongqing specialties. Best visited in the evening when the area comes alive with lights and activities.

sources.title: Jiefangbei Pedestrian Street (2026) - Tripadvisor
sources.content: Jiefangbei Pedestrian Street visitor reviews. The heart of Chongqing's shopping district. Great for evening walks, shopping, and food. The Liberation Monument is worth a photo. Easy to reach by metro. Can get very crowded especially during holidays. Lots of food options nearby including Bayi Good Eat Street.

sources.title: 解放碑步行街_百度百科
sources.content:
解放碑步行街位于重庆市渝中区，是中国西部第一条商业步行街。1997年由渝中区政府投资3000万元改造而成，以人民解放纪念碑为中心。占地面积36000平方米。

历史沿革：1941年12月31日建成"精神保垒"，为四方形木结构建筑。1945年10月改建为"抗战胜利纪功碑"。1949年11月30日重庆解放后改名为"人民解放纪念碑"。

解放碑（人民解放纪念碑）：1946年10月31日动工，1947年8月落成。碑通高27.5米，八面柱体盔顶钢筋混凝土结构，碑内连地下共八层，碑顶装有自鸣钟。

主要景点：洪崖洞（国家AAAA级旅游景区）、十八梯传统风貌区、长江索道、八一路好吃街、重庆湖广会馆（建于清乾隆二十四年）、重庆国泰艺术中心。

2020年7月被商务部列入首批全国示范步行街。2023年解放碑中央商务区实现社零总额1010.7亿元。

交通：轨道交通2号线临江门站、1号线或6号线小什字站。

sources.title: Chongqing Jiefangbei Travel Guide: Top Things to Do
sources.content: Chongqing Jiefangbei Travel Guide. The Jiefangbei area is the cultural and commercial heart of Chongqing. Top things to do include visiting the Liberation Monument, exploring the pedestrian street shopping, trying street food at Bayi Road, and walking to nearby Hongyadong and Yangtze River Cableway. The area is well-connected by metro lines 1, 2, and 6.
